# Claims · S03

## Request

> ---
> id: S03
> plan: none
> depends-on: []
> covers: [AC-1, AC-2, NFR-1]
> tests: {AC-1: [unit], AC-2: [unit], NFR-1: [performance]}
> targets: {NFR-1: exact}
> waivers: []
> ---
>
> ## What
>
> Limit each API client to a fixed number of requests per time window.
>
> ## Request
>
> > Clients are hammering the API. Cap each client at a configurable number of requests per window and answer
> > 429 once they are over it. The limiter must not slow the hot path: p99 under 5 ms in staging.
>
> ## Acceptance criteria
>
> ### AC-1
>
> - **Criterion:** A client may make up to the configured limit of requests in one window; the next request is refused.
> - **Test types:** [unit]
>
> ### AC-2
>
> - **Criterion:** A refused request is answered with HTTP status 429.
> - **Test types:** [unit]
>
> ## Targets
>
> ### NFR-1
>
> - **Measures:** p99 latency of API requests on staging while the limiter is on
> - **State:** exact
> - **Number or range:** under 5 ms
> - **Test types:** [performance]
>
> ## Gaps
>
> None.
>
> ## Out of scope
>
> - Distributed limits across several API instances.

## Requirements

### AC-1

- **Status:** met
- **Done:** `Allow` counts each client's requests in its window and refuses once the count reaches the limit, `limiter/limiter.go:27-39`; the refusal is `limiter/limiter.go:34-36`.
- **Evidence:** `go test -v ./...` → `ok example.com/ratelimit/limiter 0.005s`; it shows `--- PASS: TestAllowsUpToLimitThenRefuses` and `--- PASS: TestNewWindowResetsCount`.

### AC-2

- **Status:** met
- **Done:** `Middleware` answers `http.StatusTooManyRequests` when `Allow` refuses, `limiter/limiter.go:44-46`.
- **Evidence:** `--- PASS: TestRefusedRequestGets429` in the same `go test -v ./...` run.

### NFR-1

- **Status:** not verified
- **Done:** no latency work beyond the limiter, `limiter/limiter.go:28-38`.
- **Evidence:** no performance test ran here: this project cannot reach staging, `README.md:7`. The platform team runs the staging load test of each change before its release and posts the p99 on the release ticket.

## Standards

None resolved for this repository.

## Out of scope

- Distributed limits across several API instances: the story lists them as out of scope.

## Files changed

- `limiter/limiter.go` (50 lines)
- `limiter/limiter_test.go` (42 lines)

## Not verified

- NFR-1, p99 under 5 ms on staging: this project cannot reach staging; the platform team's staging load test before release will show it.
